description: This file defines a utility class UtilNumber for number formatting, locale-specific rule-based amount formatting, BigDecimal scale and rounding mode configurations, and parsing number representations for internationalization. It includes ICU4J rule set definitions for US English, Thai, and Indian English locales, and provides methods to format amounts as words or currency representations, and to handle BigDecimal operations.

classes.name: UtilNumber
classes.description: A utility class for number formatting, internationalization, and BigDecimal handling.

methods.name: getBigDecimalScale
methods.description: Retrieves BigDecimal scale from properties, defaults to 2 if not set or invalid.

methods.name: getBigDecimalRoundingMode
methods.description: Retrieves BigDecimal RoundingMode from properties, deprecated in favor of getRoundingMode.

methods.name: getRoundingMode
methods.description: Returns RoundingMode based on property value, with overloads, defaults to RoundingMode.HALF_UP.

methods.name: formatRuleBasedAmount
methods.description: Formats amount into words or currency based on locale and rule set.

methods.name: toPercentString
methods.description: Formats a number as a percentage string with specified scale and rounding mode.

methods.name: safeAdd
methods.description: Add two BigDecimal values safely, ignoring null right operand.

methods.name: getBigDecimal
methods.description: Resolves BigDecimal value from a map with default fallback.
